script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: A Small Town Christmas

INT. SMITH'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A cozy living room with a lit fireplace. A CHRISTMAS TREE stands proudly in the corner. JASON SMITH (30s), a kind and cheerful man, sits on a plush armchair, flipping through an old photo album.

Suddenly, JASON looks up, startled. The doorbell rings.

He gets up and heads towards the door.

INT. ENTRANCE HALL - NIGHT

JASON opens the door to reveal his childhood friend, LUCY JAMES (30s), carrying a large basket.

LUCY (excitedly): "Jason! Surprise! I brought you a basket of goodies for Christmas!"

JASON (smiling): "Lucy, it's always a pleasure to see you. Come in, come in!"

INT. SMITH'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

Jason and Lucy set the basket on the kitchen counter. They chat about old times while preparing cookies for Santa.

LUCY: "I heard you're single again, Jason."

JASON: "Yeah, it's been a while. I've given up on dating apps. They're all scams."

Lucy nods in agreement.

INT. SMITH'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

They sit by the fireplace, sipping hot cocoa, and reminiscing about their childhood.

LUCY: "Do you remember that time we got into trouble for decorating the Christmas tree with Pop-Tarts?"

JASON (laughing): "Oh, yes! Mom was so mad at us."

INT. SMITH'S ATTIC - DAY

Jason and Lucy explore the attic filled with old Christmas decorations. They find their old stockings and laugh about how much they've grown.

LUCY: "I still can't believe we fit into these."

JASON: "Yeah, I guess time does fly."

INT. SMITH'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

They gather around the Christmas tree, exchanging gifts. Jason receives a painting of the town square at Christmas, and Lucy receives a scrapbook of their memories.

JASON: "This is perfect, Lucy. I can't believe how thoughtful you are."

LUCY: "Well, you know I always have a soft spot for our small town."

INT. SMITH'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

They cook and prepare a feast for Christmas dinner. The aroma of roasted turkey, mashed potatoes, and gravy fills the room.

INT. SMITH'S DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason and Lucy sit down to enjoy their Christmas dinner. They share stories of their families and reminisce about their past.

LUCY: "Jason, I'm so glad we've reconnected. This has been the best Christmas I've had in years."

JASON: "I feel the same way, Lucy. It's been a pleasure having you here."

INT. SMITH'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

They sit by the Christmas tree, enjoying the warm glow of the fireplace.

LUCY: "I think it's time we made some new memories, don't you?"

JASON: "I couldn't agree more."

They share a warm smile as the camera fades to black.

THE END
